title: Normalized finite pullback comparison along coefficient quotient base change
statement: Let l be prime, E and L finite extensions of Q_l, and ι:E→L a Q_l-algebra embedding. Let g:X→Y, e an exponent with monotone index(e,-), j the quotient inclusions induced by ι, and source and target Coefficients data on Y and X as in def-weil-ramified-pullback-tower-data. There are natural isomorphisms between finite E-pullback followed by completed scalar extension on X and completed scalar extension on Y followed by finite L-pullback at index(e,n). They satisfy the pure-tensor formula and adjacent tower square displayed verbatim in the Lean attachment. This assumes coefficient comparison and proves only finite pullback base change; it does not assert ramification existence, coefficient comparison existence, or the same-index factorization.

source.place: Tags 03EL (lemma-tensor-product-pullback) and 03EK (section-tensor-product): inverse-image tensor comparison and balanced reassociation, original node proof steps 5–7. Context: Bhatt–Scholze Lemma 6.8.2(1).

proof.text: Apply lem-weil-ramified-finite-module-comparison separately at every n and module M. It supplies objectwise isomorphisms d_n(M) with the full nested tensor formula, before any naturality or coherence.

Prove equality of completed-L-linear maps out of scalar-extended finite E pullback by adjunction. First remove completed scalar extension with its normalized unit. The square π_E q=c_X π_L and local surjectivity of π_E let these maps be retyped as finite-coefficient linear maps. Apply the finite pullback adjunction, then finite scalar-extension extensionality. Thus equality is detected on 1⊗g*(1⊗p). For a module map f, naturality of each adjunction unit and of sheafified scalar extension shows both composites send this generator to g*(1⊗(1⊗f(p))). Hence the d_n(M) are natural. Apply this naturality to every differential of P to construct an isomorphism of cochain complexes, and to every component of a chain map to prove naturality in P. The section formula is the module formula in each degree.

For the adjacent tower square use the same extensionality test with source level n+1, target level index(e,n), and coefficient q equal to E quotient reduction followed by j_n. The projection identity and target.ramified_projection prove the required ring square. Naturality of the outer scalar tensor sends its generator to 1⊗τ_E(g*(1⊗p)); pullTensor_transition reduces this to the level-n generator. Its image under d_n is the normalized L generator. In the other composite d_(n+1) first gives the normalized L generator at index(e,n+1), and pullTensor_transition again reduces it to the identical generator at index(e,n). All coefficient factors are one, since every ring map preserves one. Module-map extensionality in each degree yields the claimed equality of chain maps. The full formula and these transition equations together give the requested witness.

theorem finitePullbackComparison_exists {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (e : ℕ) (hmono : Monotone (index e))
    (j : ∀ n : ℕ, Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1) →+*
      Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l L (index e n + 1))
    (hj : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E),
      j n (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Padic.coefficientExtensionIdeal l E (n + 1)) a) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (Padic.coefficientExtensionIdeal l L (index e n + 1))
          (integralScalarIntegerInclusion l E L ι a))
    (source : Coefficients l E L ι e j Y) (target : Coefficients l E L ι e j X) :
    ∃ levelIso : ∀ n : ℕ,
    integralOperationsPullbackLevel l E g n ⋙ scalarCx.{t, u} target.completedMap ≅
      scalarCx.{t, u} source.completedMap ⋙
        integralOperationsPullbackLevel l L g (index e n),
      ( ∀ (n : ℕ) (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ)
    (i : ℤ) (V : Y.ProEt)
    (a : (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n).obj.obj (op V))
    (b : (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n).obj.obj
      (op ((Scheme.proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V)))
    (s : (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L X).obj.obj
      (op ((Scheme.proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))) (p : (P.X i).val.obj (op V)),
    (((levelIso n).hom.app P).f i).val.app _
      (tensor target.completedMap (((integralOperationsPullbackLevel l E g n).obj P).X i)
        _ s (pullTensor l E g n P i V a b p)) =
      pullTensor l L g (index e n) ((scalarCx.{t, u} source.completedMap).obj P) i V
        ((ramifiedMap l E L Y e n (j n)).hom.app (op V) a)
        ((ramifiedMap l E L X e n (j n)).hom.app _ b *
          (completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted l L X (index e n)).hom.app _ s)
        (tensor source.completedMap (P.X i) (op V) 1 p)) ∧
      ( ∀ (n : ℕ) (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ),
    (scalarCx.{t, u} target.completedMap).map
        ((integralOperationsPullbackTransition l E g n).app P) ≫
          (levelIso n).hom.app P =
      (levelIso (n + 1)).hom.app P ≫
        transition l L g (index e n) (index e (n + 1)) (hmono (Nat.le_succ n))
          ((scalarCx.{t, u} source.completedMap).obj P))
